title: ALB HTTPS Listener + Redirect
scenario: Terminate TLS on the load balancer: an HTTPS listener on 443 with a certificate, and port 80 redirecting to HTTPS.

focus.title: Complete the HTTPS listener
focus.todo: Configure the 443/HTTPS listener with the certificate and a forward action.

hints.why: A load balancer is the stable entry point in front of changing compute. Listeners and target groups define how traffic reaches the application.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_lb_listener" "https"`. Configure the 443/HTTPS listener with the certificate and a forward action. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use a load balancer when traffic must be distributed, health-checked or terminated before reaching backend instances.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_lb_listener" "https"`. Use this code shape: port; protocol; certificate_arn; load_balancer_arn; default_action { type; target_group_arn }. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.certificate_arn`, `var.lb_arn`, `var.target_group_arn`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
